card.name: Of/in inside standard label headings
card.fires_on: The small word "of" in the heading "Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment of Fertility", and "in" in "differences in responses between the elderly and younger patients".

modes.label: Fertility heading
modes.description: The word "of" before "Fertility" in the carcinogenesis and mutagenesis section title.
modes.example: Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment<< of>> Fertility Carcinogenesis Citalop

modes.label: Geriatric use sentence
modes.description: The word "in" after "differences" in the standard sentence about elderly and younger patients.
modes.example: Other reported clinical experience has not identified differences<< in>> responses between the elderly and younger patients.
